jobs.title: LVN / LPT Case Manager
jobs.description:
Stronger Roots – Recuperative Care ProgramFull\-Time \| In\-Person

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who does not come to work with the mindset:

“I finished my job, so I’m done.”

We want someone who thinks:

“What else needs to happen, and how can I help the team be successful?”

Stronger Roots operates with a small, hands\-on team. You will have your own caseload and responsibilities, but you must also be willing to notice gaps, help with an intake, follow up on an unresolved issue, support a teammate, and step in when the program reasonably needs help.

We need someone who takes ownership, follows through, communicates, solves problems, and does not need to be told every next step.

About the Position

Stronger Roots is seeking a California Licensed Vocational Nurse (LVN) or Licensed Psychiatric Technician (LPT) for our Recuperative Care program.

This is not a traditional nursing position. It is a clinical case\-management role combining behavioral\-health support, client engagement, care coordination, documentation, and clinical follow\-up.

Our clients are often more behavioral\-health focused than medically intensive, with mental health, substance\-use, and co\-occurring conditions. Behavioral\-health experience is strongly preferred, although we are willing to train the right candidate.

The position manages approximately 35–40 clients and works closely with our RN, case\-management team, healthcare providers, behavioral\-health providers, and community partners.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage a caseload of approximately 35–40 clients.
* Complete and assist with intakes, assessments, care plans, and discharge planning.
* Maintain regular client contact and identify medical, behavioral\-health, substance\-use, and social\-service needs.
* Complete daily progress notes and required case\-management documentation.
* Review medical records, medications, discharge instructions, behavioral\-health information, and provider recommendations.
* Provide clinical support within the LVN/LPT scope of practice and appropriately escalate concerns.
* Coordinate medical care, behavioral health, psychiatry, substance\-use treatment, pharmacy, Home Health, specialty services, and other community resources.
* Coordinate appointments, referrals, transportation, prescriptions, and provider follow\-up.
* Communicate with hospitals, Managed Care Plans, healthcare providers, behavioral\-health providers, and community partners.
* Participate in case conferences and interdisciplinary team meetings.
* Help clients address barriers involving treatment, medications, benefits, housing, transportation, and recovery.
* Maintain accurate and timely electronic records.

Preferred Experience

Behavioral\-health experience is strongly preferred, particularly working with individuals with:

* Mental health conditions and serious mental illness
* Substance\-use disorders
* Co\-occurring mental health and substance\-use disorders
* Trauma and behavioral dysregulation
* Medication\-adherence challenges
* Homelessness and housing instability
* Difficulty consistently engaging in treatment

Experience in psychiatric services, behavioral health, substance\-use treatment, crisis services, community mental health, Recuperative Care, homelessness services, or case management is a plus.

Qualifications

* Current California LVN or LPT license
* Strong communication, organization, and follow\-through
* Comfortable managing approximately 35–40 clients
* Strong professional boundaries and client\-engagement skills
* Ability to recognize and appropriately escalate clinical or behavioral\-health concerns
* Strong computer and Electronic Health Record (EHR) skills
* Ability to complete accurate and timely progress notes and electronic documentation
* Comfortable working independently while remaining part of a small interdisciplinary team

Experience with trauma\-informed care, motivational interviewing, de\-escalation, crisis intervention, CPR/First Aid, Narcan, Medi\-Cal/CalAIM, or ECM is preferred.

Important

This is a full\-time, in\-person, boots\-on\-the\-ground position.

It is not a work\-from\-home position and is not intended for someone looking for a second job or simply additional nursing hours.

We are looking for someone who wants to join the team, take ownership of their clients, and help the entire program succeed.

Employment Statement

Stronger Roots is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Employment with Stronger Roots is at will, meaning either the employee or Stronger Roots may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or advance notice, subject to applicable law.

Reasonable accommodations are available to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities as required by law.

Pay: $30\.00 \- $40\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Mileage reimbursement
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* Do you agree to read the entire job posting?

Experience:

* Case management or direct patient care: 1 year (Preferred)

License/Certification:

* LVN /LPT (Required)

Work Location: On the road

jobs.title: Syringe Service Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Syringe Services Program (SSP) Coordinator

**Position:** Full\-Time, 40 hours per week

**Reports To:** Operations Manager

**Location:** 2211 Del Paso Blvd

**Compensation:** $29\-$31/hour

Position Summary

The Syringe Services Program (SSP) Coordinator oversees the day\-to\-day operations of the SSP Drop\-In Center. This hands\-on position coordinates staff and volunteers, manages inventory and supplies, prepares harm reduction kits, and delivers supplies to SSP participants.

The ideal candidate is organized, dependable, compassionate, and committed to providing respectful, confidential, and nonjudgmental harm reduction services.

Essential Duties \& Responsibilities

* Coordinate daily operations of the SSP Drop\-In Center.
* Schedule SSP employees and ensure appropriate program coverage.
* Coordinate and support SSP volunteers.
* Prepare and oversee the assembly of harm reduction kits.
* Maintain accurate inventory of syringes, naloxone, safer\-use materials, and other program supplies.
* Receive, organize, stock, and monitor program supplies.
* Anticipate inventory needs and help prevent supply shortages.
* Prepare and deliver harm reduction supplies to SSP participants.
* Provide respectful, confidential, and nonjudgmental participant services.
* Provide harm reduction and overdose prevention information and connect participants with community resources when appropriate.
* Maintain required program records and documentation.
* Follow confidentiality, bloodborne pathogen, sharps\-handling, and workplace safety procedures.
* Participate in staff meetings, training, and other program activities as needed.

Driving Requirements

Because supply delivery is an essential part of this position, the employee must:

* Possess a valid driver’s license.
* Maintain a driving record that meets organizational requirements.
* Have access to a reliable, insured vehicle for work\-related travel.
* Maintain automobile insurance and meet the organization’s insurability requirements.
* Be willing and able to deliver supplies throughout the program’s service area.

Qualifications

* Strong organizational, communication, and time\-management skills.
* Ability to coordinate employees, volunteers, inventory, and daily program activities.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Basic computer and recordkeeping skills.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and professional boundaries.
* Commitment to harm reduction and participant autonomy.
* Ability to work respectfully with people who use drugs and individuals experiencing barriers to traditional services.
* Fluent in Spanish

**Preferred:** Previous experience in syringe services, harm reduction, outreach, public health, social services, staff or volunteer coordination, or inventory management. Knowledge of overdose prevention and naloxone administration is also preferred.

Relevant lived experience is valued.

Physical \& Work Requirements

This position requires regular driving and may involve standing, lifting up to 50lbs on a daily basis, transporting supplies, stocking inventory, and working around syringes and other potentially hazardous materials. Appropriate training and protective equipment will be provided.

Our Approach

Our Syringe Services Program is grounded in harm reduction, dignity, respect, and participant choice. The SSP Coordinator helps ensure participants have consistent access to supplies, information, resources, and support in a welcoming and nonjudgmental environment.

*SANE provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.*

Pay: $29\.00 \- $31\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Case Manager II PRN/Day
jobs.description:
**Facility** Kindred Hospital San Gabriel Valley  

**Req ID** 558441 **Post Date** 09/06/2026  


  

**Description**  

Kindred Hospital San Gabriel Valley is a 76\-bed long\-term acute care hospital offering the same in\-depth care you would receive in a traditional hospital, but for an extended recovery period. We partner with your physician and offer 24\-hour clinical care seven days a week so you can start your journey to wellness. We are located just over 2 miles outside of downtown West Covina, and right down the street from Covina Square Shopping Center.

**Job Summary**


Coordinates and facilitates the care of the patient population through effective collaboration and communication with the Interdisciplinary Care Transitions (ICT) team members. Follows patients throughout the continuum of care and ensures optimum utilization of resources, service delivery and compliance with external review agencies. Provides ongoing support and expertise through comprehensive assessment, care planning, plan implementation and overall evaluation of individual patient needs. Enhances the quality of patient management and satisfaction, to promote continuity of care and cost effectiveness through the integration of functions of case management, utilization review and management, and discharge planning.

**Essential Functions**  

**Care Coordination**

* Coordinates clinical and/or psycho\-social activities with the Interdisciplinary Team and Physicians.
* Monitors all areas of patients’ stay for effective care coordination and efficient care facilitation.
* Remains current from a knowledge base perspective regarding reimbursement modalities, community resources, case management, psychosocial and legal issues that affect patients and providers of care.
* Appropriately refers high risk patients who would benefit from additional support.
* Serves as a patient advocate. Enhances a collaborative relationship to maximize the patient’s and family’s ability to make informed decisions.
* Demonstrates knowledge of the principles of growth and development over the life span and the skills necessary to provide age appropriate care to the patient population served.
* Participates in interdisciplinary patient care rounds and/or conferences to review treatment goals, optimize resource utilization, provide family education and identified post hospital needs. Collaborates with clinical staff in the development and execution of the plan of care, and achievement of goals.
* Coordinates with interdisciplinary care team, physicians, patients, families, post\-acute providers, payors, and others in the planning of the patients’ care throughout the care continuum.

**Knowledge/Skills/Abilities/Expectations**

* Knowledge of government and non\-government payor practices, regulations, standards and reimbursement.
* Knowledge of Medicare benefits and insurance processes and contracts.
* Knowledge of accreditation standards and compliance requirements.
* Ability to demonstrate critical thinking, appropriate prioritization and time management skills.
* Basic computer skills with working knowledge of Microsoft Office, word\-processing and spreadsheet software.
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal and written skills in order to communicate effectively and to obtain cooperation/collaboration from hospital leadership, as well as physicians, payors and other external customers
* Demonstrates good interpersonal skills when working or interacting with patients, their families and other staff members.
* Approximate percent of time required to travel, 0%
* Must read, write and speak fluent English.
* Must have good and regular attendance.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.


Pay Range: $47\.26\-$59\.93/hr.


ScionHealth has a comprehensive benefits package for benefit\-eligible employees that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness.

* Bachelor’s Degree in nursing or social work: BSN, MSN, BSW or MSW (Preferred)

**Licenses/Certifications*** RN \- Registered Nurse \- State Licensure and/or Compact State Licensure in the state of practice Upon Hire (Required) Or
* LCSW\- License Clinical Social Worker LCSW or LSW Upon Hire (Required) Or

jobs.description:
**Description**

Providence is calling for applications for our **November 2026 RN Case Management Fellowship at Providence Cedars\-Sinai Tarzana Medical Center.**

An RN Fellow at Providence will experience a guided transition into their new specialty through structured curriculum, experienced preceptors and hands\-on learning. If you are an RN ready to transition to a new specialty and have more than 12 months of continuous RN work experience, the Providence Clinical Academy is for you.


The RN Fellowship position starts on **November 2, 2026\.**

**Positions available: Full\-Time, Variable shifts**

Case Management is a collaborative practice including patients, caregivers, nurses, social workers, physicians, payers, support staff, other practitioners and the community. The Case Management process facilitates communication and care coordination along a continuum through effective transitional care management. Recognizing the patient's right to self\-determination, the significance of the social determinants of health and the complexities of care.


Providence Cedars\-Sinai Tarzana Medical Center, recognized as one of the best regional hospitals in 9 types of care by U.S. News \& World Report. Awarded Healthgrades' Patient Safety Excellence Award for 2024 and America’s 50 Best Hospitals for Vascular Surgery Award in 2025, we provide exceptional patient care with a commitment to excellence.


Providence caregivers are not simply valued – they’re invaluable. Join our team at Providence Tarzana Medical Center and thrive in our culture of patient\-focused, whole\-person care built on understanding, commitment, and mutual respect. Your voice matters here, because we know that to inspire and retain the best people, we must empower them.


**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in nursing, preferred, or equivalent educ/experience
* All Registered Nurses without a minimum of a bachelor’s degree in nursing must obtain a bachelor’s degree in nursing or higher within 3 years of hire.
* Any previously agreed upon effective date for obtaining a bachelor’s degree in nursing between individual and facility will remain in effect.
* Any collective bargaining contract with specific time frames for obtaining a bachelor’s degree in nursing will supersede the above point and will remain in effect.
* Exceptions will be considered on a case\-by\-case basis at each ministry by the Director of Care Management in consultation with the Human Resources.
* RNs employed prior to 8/2021 are encouraged to obtain a bachelor’s degree or higher degree in Nursing, but obtaining the degree will not be a condition of employment.
* Upon hire: California Registered Nurse License
* California Fire and Life Safety Card \- National Organization within 30 days of hire
* 2 years of experience in healthcare related field (Acute, Ambulatory, Post\-Acute, etc.).
* 2 years of experience in Case Management (Care Coordination or Utilization Management) or successful completion of the Transitions in Practice (TIP) program for Care Manager. TIP candidates must have experience in same type of nursing unit in which the CM position is available.

**Qualifications:**

* Master's degree in healthcare related field.
* Upon hire: Certification in Case Management (ACM or CCM)

**Why Join Providence?**

Our best\-in\-class benefits are uniquely designed to support you and your family in staying well, growing professionally, and achieving financial security. We take care of you, so you can focus on delivering our Mission of caring for everyone, especially the most vulnerable in our communities.


**About Providence**

At Providence, our strength lies in Our Promise of “Know me, care for me, ease my way.” Working at our family of organizations means that regardless of your role, we’ll walk alongside you in your career, supporting you so you can support others. We provide best\-in\-class benefits and we foster an inclusive workplace where diversity is valued, and everyone is essential, heard and respected. Together, our 120,000 caregivers (all employees) serve in over 50 hospitals, over 1,000 clinics and a full range of health and social services across Alaska, California, Montana, New Mexico, Oregon, Texas and Washington. As a comprehensive health care organization, we are serving more people, advancing best practices and continuing our more than 100\-year tradition of serving the poor and vulnerable.
